vars.prTitle: fix(credentials): don't cancel unpaid bookings when the pending payment can't be voided
vars.prBody: When a payment app is removed we cancel every unpaid booking of the affected event types and delete their payments. The result of `deletePayment` was ignored, so if the provider failed to expire the checkout session the booking was cancelled (and attendees emailed) while the attendee could still pay it. We now only delete the payment row when the payment app confirms it was voided, and leave the booking untouched if any of its payments could not be voided.
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "The new logic treats `deletePayment(...) === false` as 'the provider failed to void the payment', but that is only Stripe's meaning. The IAbstractPaymentService implementations for PayPal (packages/app-store/paypal/lib/PaymentService.ts:193-194), Alby (packages/app-store/alby/lib/PaymentService.ts:134-135) and the mock payment app are stubs that always resolve `false`, and packages/lib/payment/deletePayment.ts also returns false when the app has no PaymentService. So removing a PayPal or Alby credential no longer cancels any unpaid booking: the bookings stay PENDING (holding their slots) on event types whose payment app was just stripped from metadata, their Payment rows are never deleted, and no cancellation emails are sent. Only Stripe, which returns true after expiring sessions and cancelling the intent, gets the intended behaviour.", "severity": "High"}]
